reading_notes: Every primary row retains three full-pipeline seeds on fixed physical flights.
CSV numbers are mean +/- sample SD. Contrast accuracy differences use the original percent scale, not relative percent change.
A positive accuracy contrast is favorable; a negative FA or delay contrast is favorable. No combined winner score is used.
Primary delay is the mean of native per-seed conditional medians. Auxiliary delay is a mean of matched-flight paired-difference medians.
Frozen local RF is the exact probability-producing input model, not the raw300ms RF baseline.
Three seed repeats do not establish significance, and gains cannot be generalized to all classifier families.
scope: Fixed two heads by four input masks by two tasks by three pipeline seeds, plus six frozen RF references. No VLM study or raw flight records included.
